one_liner: Clay has a REST Public API (api.clay.com/public/v0) using a self-serve API key, available on all plans including Free, plus an official hosted OAuth MCP server.
auth_notes: Public API uses clay-api-key header with user-generated key. OAuth 2.1 with DCR applies to the MCP server only, not the main REST API.
access_notes: Developer platform (API/CLI) is available on all plans including Free; Free caps search results at 100 per 30 days. Editor/Admin workspace access is needed.
blocker_notes: Public API is limited in scope: it runs functions and searches, reads tables and checks credits, but cannot write to tables. Inbound webhooks on paid plans handle writes.

evidence.quote: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the `clay-api-key` header.
Auth is OAuth 2.1 against Clay with Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) and PKCE.
The developer platform is available across all Clay plans, including free, trial, and Legacy plans.
Clay's Public API is a REST API at `api.clay.com/public/v0`
It cannot create or write to tables; inbound webhooks still do that.
Cursor plugin that connects agents to [Clay](https://www.clay.com) through Clay's official hosted [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server.
